name: Connection Proxy
summary: Adversaries may use a connection proxy to direct network traffic between systems or act as an intermediary for network communications. The definition of a proxy can also be expanded to encompass trust relationships between networks in peer-to-peer, mesh, or trusted connections between networks consisting of hosts or systems that regularly communicate with each other. analytics.name: Analytic 1891
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process with both a listening socket on an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port and an outbound connection to a non-ICS destination, or iptables DNAT/REDIRECT rules added on ICS protocol ports. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2175
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a host simultaneously maintaining an inbound connection on an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port and an outbound connection to a destination outside the ICS network zone, detectable as correlated dual flows with matching timing and approximate byte-count proportionality. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
